description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Notifying that the market Rate of Interest for the purpose of Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act, shall be 7.06% per annum w.e.f. 01.01.2017
categorisation: This gazette content contains a notification from the Central Bank of Sri Lanka establishing the Market Rate of Interest under the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act. It represents a regulatory determination made by the Monetary Board exercising powers vested by specific legislation, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, structural, or other specialized category.
